title: Affine chart tensor sections transported through the overlap
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring and C its maximal-ideal completion, with φ:A→C [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let U⊆Spec A be open, q:Y→U, E affine, s:E→Spec C and D:CompletionGluingData A U q E s [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. For f∈A suppose D(f)⊆U and V=(q followed by U inclusion)⁻¹D(f) affine. Then C tensor_A (the fixed chart section module for f [def-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-section-modules]), with scalar extension as in [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data], is C-linearly equivalent to Γ(E,s⁻¹D(φ(f))) with its structural C-action. This statement involves neither localization of Γ(E,top) nor a choice of A-linear transition equivalence.

source.place: Tags 01JO, Lemma 26.17.2 (affine fibre products); 0BLH, first two proof paragraphs; 05EL, item (1).

proof.text: Restrict the supplied overlap isomorphism to the inverse image of the affine chart V. Since D(f) lies in U, this restriction is the pullback of V→Spec A along Spec C→Spec A. D.over identifies the restriction on the completed side with s⁻¹D(φ(f)), over Spec C.

The affine fibre-product formula gives its section ring as C tensor_A Γ(Y,V). Transport through the restricted overlap isomorphism. chartSectionModule_smul identifies the chart A-action with its structural action. The structural maps are over Spec C, so the transported equivalence is C-linear. Empty charts give zero rings on both sides.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_chart_tensor_sections
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens} {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme}
    {E : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine E] {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))}
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (f : A)
    (hf : PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f ≤ U)
    (hV : IsAffineOpen ((q ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f)) :
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let φ := algebraMap A C
    let W := s ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (φ f)
    letI : Module C Γ(E, W) := Module.compHom _
      ((ΓSpecIso (.of C)).inv ≫ s.appTop ≫
        E.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op).hom
    let N := ModuleCat.of C Γ(E, W)
    Nonempty (FormalGlueing.extend φ
      (FormalGlueing.piece f (chartSectionModule (q ≫ U.ι) f)) ≃ₗ[C] N)
